item.title: Undertow
item.description:
My Notes

sitting down in garden desk
postprandial dark illuminari
equipment magic abound
yet still the formless field
of resistance's pulled us
from entering the sound's
source, at first,
distractors inferred later,
includenza's wicked sense
of doubt about
boredom's core
deception.

prev's 22-Sun,
the temple of LPP-Seq arose,
helping us tonight to peel away
at the resistors,
to enter the portal
of signal's awareness.

four Stations on were discovered on the receiver.

item.title: Four Lanterns
item.description:
The four tracks of the Sequencer glow orange, violet, green and salmon, and each one gets its own MicroFreak preset. One at a time, a pattern goes into the sequencer, the sound is recorded as audio, and its loop keeps going while the instrument turns to the next voice.

Listen for the third voice changing shape while it records, for the room opening as reverb rises and the loops pan apart, and for the hat returning on the first track in the second scene.

item.title: Fallveter - Empty Billiards Hall
item.description:
Notes from Acolyte

the clock - 8 + 4 + 2 + 1

The hall keeps time in half-minutes. Each thirty seconds holds one gesture struck twice: 8 + 4 + 2 + 1 = 15 beats at 60 BPM.

The 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 planned for 07-Sat returns here reversed, and played in sequence as that ceremony first intended.

The gesture was set down before the meetup on the 09 Sequencer, its patterns chained into one five-minute line and kept as a Launchpad Project.

voices in the rack

The Piano Pool rack holds what the empty hall gave on Veterans Day: piano notes, and cue balls struck on the pool table. One more voice comes from the Forevertron.

The low-battery chirp of 399 FireAlarmLoBat, a sine at G7, is a signal from a battery running down. It calls most half-minutes to order.

the pad that answers

259 Infini Pad answers from the MicroFreak's 05 Keys, caught and looped on two tracks.

Pressure on the touch keys feeds the BASS oscillator's Fold and Saturate and opens the Cutoff. The pad thickens under the fingers.

process and hand

In Music as a Gradual Process, a process and an improvisation exclude each other. This ceremony keeps one of each: the drum line runs as a process, fixed before the ceremony began, and the loops are caught by hand.

Reich also wrote that playing and hearing a gradual process is an impersonal kind of ritual, attention turned away from the players and out toward the process.

listen for

The loops walk through F, F minor, G and F, then settle on a low C3, under a clock that never changes.

At 03:20 the hall goes almost silent.

item.title: Infini Pad at the Crossfader
item.description:
One pad, four loops, and a crossfader leaning the signal from one side to the other. Low C pedals swell under the fingers, a high G hangs over the field, and near 18:00 the transmission sinks almost to nothing before the bass climbs back in. At 28:14 the ghost speaks: a field report from the crossfader.

A single sound, 259 Infini Pad, plays every part: chord, drone, beacon and bass. Phrases played on the MicroFreak keys are caught by the Launchpad's sequencer and sent back, so the instrument keeps answering itself.

The loops sit on two sides of 05 Using Live's Crossfader: layers 1A and 2A on the A side, 1B and 2B on the B side. Layer 2B also passes through the A side on its way out, so it sounds loudest with the crossfader near the middle. Listen for the side changing, then for what stays when it does.

The music stays in C minor until 22:39, when an E from the keys turns the chord to C major for under a minute.

item.title: Infini Pad bass and 8bitfi
item.description: The Launchpad plays Infini Pad high and slow, then the MicroFreak keys turn it into a noisy bass. At 18:17 8bitfi takes over with key pressure, warbling and pitch bends over the looping pad layers.

item.title: Hallowed Speaking
item.description: The ghost made a hot appearance here for a live fall fest. Speech patches caught the vibe, gave way to swelling pads, unstable tones and filtered noise, with phrases captured and returned as overlapping audio loops.

item.description: A Ghost in the Patch session with three MicroFreak factory presets in layered takes: NoiseBusters opens as a hall of mirrors, Fight comes in as a lead with pad pressure, and TaBass enters near the end as a little thumper, with cycling-envelope and filter sweeps throughout.

item.title: GitP.26.10.06 — Chords, Formants, and Sequencers
item.description: A MicroFreak improvisation starting from an initialized patch: chord oscillators, cycling-envelope and LFO modulation, and a turn toward formant sounds. Shimmering textures give way to a gruff emergence, a ballpark organ, and a trippy denouement, with the Launchpad sequencer and MicroFreak arpeggiator along the way.
